content.text: {"id":"0ab1f620-523a-4584-96e0-2f98b3d085d0","audio_id":"09daa235-40ad-4051-8ebf-47ad245a0970","status":"complete","created_at":"2026-11-23T00:28:04Z","answer":"The solo female voice is clear, light, and friendly, and the recurring refrain is tuneful and easy to anticipate; its repeated words and short lines suit copying, though some phrases have only modest breathing room. The hook has a gently arching, wave-like contour—lifting and falling, then a small rise into the line ending—over a steady, buoyant 4/4 bounce. The main refrain is regular and easy to echo; the intervening movement lines are somewhat samey. Both target words, 나비 and 꽃, are audible and clear, with no obvious pronunciation error or prominent audio artifact. The closing line begins “다음에 또 같이 놀…” but is cut off at the end, so the final phrase does not finish cleanly. Instrumental breaks longer than two seconds are approximately 0:33–0:35, 0:50–0:52, and 1:17–1:19. Overall, this is age-appropriate, with the abrupt ending and somewhat repetitive middle section the main concerns."}
